name: Dissemination Data 1
definition: Information regarding the dissemination of data.

DisseminationIdentifier.name: Dissemination Identifier
DisseminationIdentifier.definition: Trade repository generated unique and random identifier for each publicly disseminated message.

OriginalDisseminationIdentifier.name: Original Dissemination Identifier
OriginalDisseminationIdentifier.definition: Trade repository generated unique and random identifier of the original, publicly-disseminated swap transaction and pricing data.||Usage: OriginalDisseminationIdentifier is applicable only for action types other than New.

TimeStamp.name: Time Stamp
TimeStamp.definition: Date and time, to the nearest second, that a trade repository publicly disseminates trade data.
